gloss_en: the 'man of understanding' (ish tevunot, Proverbs 20:5) — the person of tevunah who, like one drawing deep waters, draws up and reveals the hidden counsels (eitzot); in Likutey Moharan II:5 he is one possessing a refined soul ('the breath of Shaddai gives them understanding'), who by drawing divine spirituality into constrictions purifies the soul and thereby rectifies faith
